arguments.text: 10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m out-and-back. Pacer sets effort from the pod reserve (cp_shaft 159 W, 15.9 kJ, may be 10-25 pct off). My jobs: (1) check pod gain stays honest: compare pod power, boat-model power, GPS speed, heart rate and stroke rate across legs in the SAME direction (measure/legs); a pod that drifts shows pod power up but HR/rate/speed flat -> set pod_gain. (2) weed/drag: share of pod power reaching boat falls in both directions, clear_rudder fixes it. (3) radio messages: course changes -> set_race_distance + tell. (4) watch HR vs pod reserve to judge if CP is off. Keep cues few; let pacer set effort.

If HR keeps climbing and reserve hits 0 with a forced drop, CP test is roughly right; if HR flattens below max and speed holds, CP is higher than 159.

10.3 min: piece took effect ~500 s: pod 160-164 W, HR 183->179 falling slowly over 2 min, pod reserve flat ~9 pct. Paddler said cooked; I reassured (effort sustainable). Evidence CP ~159-165 W shaft (test about right). Speed at same rate -6.6 pct is from my lower-effort piece, not fatigue. Current symmetric: push_local +0.25 north, -0.24 south (no weed sign).
